translation: Among them, for more than forty years, in Qi, Lu, Wu, Yue, Chu, Yue, Yan, and Yu, I galloped north and south, my footprints never stopping; I experienced local river works and officialdom; bound by the reins of fame and the fetters of profit, I tasted all the hardships. What I relied on to stand firm in this was peace, harmony, simplicity, and ease, being willing to suffer loss and not seize advantage, always keeping the teaching of knowing when to stop and having stability, never having a mind of contention or unwillingness, and my nature from childhood has run straight through to the present. In the winter month of the jihai year, I was introduced and further received an audience, and because my talents were mediocre, I was retired; this was Heaven resting me in the front.
